title: WorkRestInterval
description: Prescribed work/rest interval per hour per USMC 6200.1E §3.2. workMinutes + restMinutes typically sum to 60 except in the cease_work case (both zero).

workMinutes.description: Minutes of work per hour. Zero when ceaseWork=true.

restMinutes.description: Minutes of rest per hour. Zero when ceaseWork=true.

cyclesUntilReassessRequired.description: If non-null, the worker must be reassessed for heat-stress symptoms after this many work/rest cycles. Null for white/green where no scheduled reassessment is required.

ceaseWork.description: True when the matrix prescribes no work (red/unacclim, black/unacclim). Workers must move to refuge.
